title: Fix empty Spoonacular results: use food names and subtypes for search
body:
- Collect full food objects instead of unusable compound keys
- Use human-readable name as query parameter
- Pick random subtype as includeIngredients for specificity
- Simplify sparkling/rosé threshold logic
